pitch_script: Rural electric co-ops keep the lights on with thin crews spread across long, exposed feeder lines. Today those crews find failures only after members call in, and members of our pilot co-ops averaged 286 outage minutes in 2025. Two things have changed. Smart-meter coverage at our target co-ops reached 74% in 2025, and new state resilience rules taking effect in 2026 require annual outage-risk plans. Co-ops that keep reacting will fall behind on reliability and on compliance. Tidewell Forecast predicts feeder-level failures up to 10 days ahead by combining smart-meter voltage signals with weather and asset age, so crews fix problems before members lose power. Three obstacles stand in the way, and we remove each one. Data is scattered across meters, SCADA and GIS, so our pre-built connectors go live in under two weeks. Small co-ops have no data scientists, so we deliver prioritised work orders. Crew time is scarce, so we provide risk-ranked patrol routes. At Pilot Co-op A, outage minutes fell 31% over six months. We now have nine signed co-op customers, four paid pilots and 118% net revenue retention. We are raising a $4M seed round to reach $4M in ARR and 30 co-op customers by Q4 2027.

positioning.text: Predictive outage prevention for rural electric cooperatives.

problem_why_now.text: Rural electric co-ops run thin crews across long, exposed feeder lines and find failures only after members call in; members of Tidewell's pilot co-ops averaged 286 outage minutes in 2025. Smart-meter coverage at target co-ops reached 74% in 2025, and new state resilience rules effective 2026 require annual outage-risk plans.

solution_benefit.text: Tidewell Forecast predicts feeder-level failures up to 10 days ahead by combining smart-meter voltage signals with weather and asset age. Pre-built connectors go live in under two weeks, and co-ops receive prioritised work orders and risk-ranked patrol routes without needing analysts, so crews fix problems before members lose power.

market_business_model.text: 812 US distribution co-ops in the target segment at an average contract value of $95K per year: a stated serviceable market of $77M per year. SaaS subscription at $1.10 per meter per year on three-year contracts billed annually; gross margin 78% (FY2025).

traction_evidence.text: 9 signed co-op customers, 4 paid pilots under way and 12 co-ops in pipeline; net revenue retention 118% (trailing 12 months). Pilot Co-op A recorded 31% fewer outage minutes over six months (Mar-Aug 2026 vs. 2025).

differentiation.text: Built for co-ops with 5,000-80,000 meters rather than investor-owned utilities; deploys in 2 weeks versus 6-9 months for incumbents. US provisional patent application filed March 2026.
